title: QwenGyre: An Elastic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Training xLong-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.33848v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly undertake extreme-long (xlong) horizon tasks, where a single execution can span hours, hundreds of model--environment interactions, and nearly 1M tokens per rollout. Applying online reinforcement learning (RL) to such executions poses two fundamental challenges: (1) severe execution variance and prolonged rollout delays cause massive GPU idling; and (2) complex non-linear branching generates massive trajectory redundancy, crippling training efficiency. To address these, we presents QwenGyre, an end-to-end framework for xlong-horizon online RL. QwenGyre elastically reallocates GPUs between rollout and training without interrupting live executions, while its trajectory processor reconstructs branching histories, scores partial progress, and deduplicates redundant paths to bound training costs. Scaled to our flagship model, Qwen~3.8 2.4T, with 700K tokens per rollout, QwenGyre yields a 6.0%

translated_title: QwenGyre：一种用于训练超长时程智能体的弹性强化学习框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地承担极端长时程任务，单次执行可能持续数小时、包含数百次模型-环境交互，且每次rollout接近100万token。将在线强化学习（RL）应用于此类执行面临两个根本性挑战：（1）严重的执行方差和漫长的rollout延迟导致大量GPU闲置；（2）复杂的非线性分支产生海量轨迹冗余，严重损害训练效率。为解决这些问题，我们提出了QwenGyre，一个面向超长时程在线RL的端到端框架。QwenGyre能够在不中断正在进行的执行的情况下，在rollout和训练之间弹性地重新分配GPU；同时，其轨迹处理器可以重建分支历史、为部分进展打分，并对冗余路径去重，从而控制训练成本。在扩展到我们的旗舰模型Qwen 3.8 2.4T（每次rollout达70万token）时，QwenGyre带来了6.0%的提升
tldr: QwenGyre提出了一种面向超长时程LLM智能体的端到端弹性在线强化学习框架，通过在不中断执行的情况下在rollout与训练之间动态重分配GPU，并利用轨迹处理器重建分支历史、为部分进展打分和去重冗余路径，有效解决了GPU大量闲置与轨迹冗余两大难题。
en_tdlr: QwenGyre is an end-to-end elastic reinforcement learning framework for extreme-long-horizon LLM agents that dynamically reallocates GPUs between rollout and training without interrupting executions, while reconstructing branching histories, scoring partial progress, and deduplicating redundant trajectories to tackle GPU idling and trajectory redundancy.
